# VOX Digital Agency

> Worldwide Full-Service Digital Agency delivering bespoke brand design, high-performance web engineering, conversion-first e-commerce, and intelligent AI automation for ambitious brands globally.

VOX Digital Agency operates globally, delivering category-defining digital flagships for startups, scaling businesses, and established enterprises across North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

## Core Services

- [Website Development](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/website-development): High-performance marketing websites, corporate platforms, and content hubs engineered with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with guaranteed 95+ Lighthouse performance.
- [WordPress Development](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/wordpress-development): Modern enterprise WordPress builds with custom Gutenberg block themes, headless front-ends, and hardened plugin architecture.
- [Shopify Development](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/shopify-development): Shopify Plus storefronts, Hydrogen/Remix headless commerce, custom themes, and conversion-engineered checkout flows.
- [WooCommerce Development](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/woocommerce-development): Scalable WooCommerce stores optimized for high-volume catalogs, custom payment gateways, and headless front-ends.
- [Webflow Website Development](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/webflow-development): Launch-ready Webflow sites with clean CMS collections, responsive structure, and custom interactions.
- [Figma to WordPress](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/figma-to-wordpress): Pixel-perfect conversion of Figma designs into clean, maintainable, editor-friendly WordPress block themes.
- [Custom Web Applications](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/custom-web-applications): Full-stack SaaS platforms, portals, dashboards, and internal tooling on Next.js, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
- [AI Agents & Business Automation](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/ai-agents-business-automation): Autonomous AI agents, workflow automation, and RAG pipelines integrated into Slack, CRM, and internal databases.
- [Technical SEO & Performance](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/seo-optimization): Core Web Vitals optimization, Schema.org structured data, crawl architecture, and international SEO.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/google-business-profile): Local SEO, Google Maps pack optimization, review generation, citations, and verified profile management.
- [UI/UX Design & Branding](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/ui-ux-design): Design systems, Figma component libraries, motion design, UX research, and responsive web/mobile user interfaces.
- [Logo & Brand Design](https://voxdigitalagency.co/services/logo-brand-design): Distinctive logo marks, color theory, typography systems, brand guidelines, and complete visual identity suites.

## Pricing Packages

- [Launch Package ($499)](https://voxdigitalagency.co/pricing): For startups and small businesses establishing their online presence. Up to 5 pages, modern responsive design, basic SEO, contact forms, speed optimization, SSL security, Google Analytics integration, and 14 days of post-launch support.
- [Growth Package ($1,199)](https://voxdigitalagency.co/pricing): Most popular package for scaling companies. Up to 15 pages, custom UI/UX design, CMS integration & blog setup, technical SEO & schema markup, performance optimization, basic AI automation & booking forms, Google Analytics conversion tracking, and 30 days of post-launch support.
- [Enterprise Package (Custom Quote)](https://voxdigitalagency.co/pricing): Bespoke digital solutions for established organizations with complex workflows, custom API integrations, enterprise SLAs, dedicated project management, AI agents, and ongoing priority support.
